title: ESPD Instance Data — Part IV (Selection criteria)
description: EXPERIMENTAL canonical instance-data model for Part IV of the ESPD standard form: selection criteria. Scoped for now to a single criterion, C31 (slc-stand-to-spec-avg, 'Specific average turnover'), used as the probe for the BUYER/REQUEST side of the request/response split. Unlike the Part III exclusion grounds (which carry no buyer data), a selection criterion carries BOTH a buyer-set `requirement` (thresholds the contracting authority declares in the REQUEST) and an economic-operator `response` (the answer supplied in the RESPONSE). Models instance data only — deliberately independent of the form definition, UI, and XML serialization. Code-list values are bare codes.

selectionCriteria.description: Selection criteria keyed by the stable criterion code (the ESPD-EDM `code`, e.g. 'slc-stand-to-spec-avg'). Keying by semantic code rather than by form tag (C31) keeps the instance data stable if the form re-numbers criteria. Each criterion holds BOTH request (buyer) and response (economic operator) data via `requirement`/`response` sub-objects (see docs/model-xml-mapping.md). Only criteria actually present in the exchange need appear.

specificAverageTurnoverCriterion.description: The 'specific average turnover' selection criterion (C31). Split into `requirement` (buyer/request side) and `response` (economic-operator side), mirroring the ESPD document boundary. This is the first criterion in the model to carry a real `requirement`, exercising the previously-unbuilt buyer/request mapping.

specificAverageTurnoverRequirement.description: The buyer/contracting-authority side (maps to/from the REQUEST document as cac:TenderingCriterionProperty[TypeCode=REQUIREMENT] Expected* values). The buyer declares which lot(s) the criterion applies to, and — for the required number of fiscal years and business domain — the minimum average turnover the economic operator must have.

lotIdentifiers.description: The lot(s) this selection criterion applies to (C31/RG1/RQ1, LOT_IDENTIFIER, cardinality 1..n). Selection criteria are lot-specific (Schematron BR-LOT-40); each entry maps to a cbc:ExpectedID in the request. Bare lot ids (e.g. 'LOT-0000').

numberOfYears.description: Number of fiscal years the requirement covers (C31/RG1/RSG1/RQ1, QUANTITY_YEAR). Maps to cbc:ExpectedValueNumeric (with unitCode=YEAR) in the request.

businessDomain.description: Description of the business area covered by the contract (C31/RG1/RSG1/RQ2, DESCRIPTION). Maps to cbc:ExpectedDescription in the request.

specificAverageTurnoverResponse.description: The economic operator's full answer to C31 (maps to/from the RESPONSE document as cac:TenderingCriterionResponse Response* values). Covers every QUESTION in RG1/RSG1: `fulfilledByItself` (QSG1/Q1) and the ONFALSE relied-upon branch (`reliedUpon`/`reliedUponEntity`); `turnover` — the period + amount answer with its own electronic-evidence block (QSG2); `startTrading` — the fallback set-up/started-trading date with its own electronic-evidence block, used when turnover is not available for the whole period (QSG3); and `electronicEvidence` — the criterion-level 'is this information available electronically?' block (QSG4).

fulfilledByItself.description: Whether the economic operator fulfils the criterion by itself (C31/RG1/RSG1/QSG1/Q1, INDICATOR).

reliedUpon.description: In the case of NO (does not fulfil by itself) — whether the EO relies upon another entity's capacity (C31/RG1/RSG1/QSG1/QSG1/Q1, INDICATOR). Expected only when `fulfilledByItself` is false.

allOf.$comment: Mirrors the form's ONFALSE branch (QSG1/QSG1): the relied-upon question is only relevant when the EO does NOT fulfil the criterion by itself.

startTrading.description: Fallback for when turnover (general or specific) is not available for the entire required period (C31/RG1/RSG1/QSG3). `date` is the date the economic operator was set up or started trading (QSG3/Q1, DATE); `electronicEvidence` is the QSG3/QSG1 'available electronically?' block for that fact.

date.description: Date on which the economic operator was set up or started trading (C31/RG1/RSG1/QSG3/Q1, DATE). ISO 8601 date.

reliedUponEntity.description: The entity whose capacity the EO relies upon (C31/RG1/RSG1/QSG1/QSG1/QSG1, ONTRUE — only when `reliedUpon` is true). `name` is the entity name (DESCRIPTION); `id` is its identifier (ECONOMIC_OPERATOR_IDENTIFIER).

name.description: Name of the relied-upon entity (C31/RG1/RSG1/QSG1/QSG1/QSG1/Q1, DESCRIPTION).

id.description: Identifier of the relied-upon entity (C31/RG1/RSG1/QSG1/QSG1/QSG1/Q2, ECONOMIC_OPERATOR_IDENTIFIER).

turnover.description: The economic operator's turnover answer (C31/RG1/RSG1/QSG2). `period` is the reporting period (PERIOD, Q1); `amount` is the specific average turnover for that period (AMOUNT, Q2); `electronicEvidence` is the QSG2/QSG1 'available electronically?' block for the turnover figure.

amount.description: A monetary amount with its currency. Maps to a UBL amount element carrying a currencyID attribute (e.g. cbc:MinimumAmount@currencyID for the requirement, cbc:ResponseAmount@currencyID for the response).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (bare code, e.g. 'EUR'). Maps to the currencyID attribute.

period.description: A reporting period (C31/RG1/RSG1/QSG2/Q1, PERIOD). Maps to UBL cac:ApplicablePeriod (StartDate/EndDate).

startDate.description: Start of the period (maps to cbc:StartDate).

endDate.description: End of the period (maps to cbc:EndDate).

electronicEvidence.description: The 'is this information available electronically?' block (C31/RG1/RSG1/QSG2/QSG1). Shared shape with Part III. `availableElectronically` is the indicator; when true, `evidence` lists one or more evidence references (EVIDENCE_IDENTIFIER, cardinality 1..n).

availableElectronically.description: Whether the supporting information/documentation is available electronically (C31/RG1/RSG1/QSG2/QSG1/Q1, INDICATOR).

evidence.description: References to the electronically-available evidence (C31/RG1/RSG1/QSG2/QSG1/QSG1/Q1, EVIDENCE_IDENTIFIER). Expected (1..n) only when `availableElectronically` is true.

allOf.$comment: Mirrors ONTRUE: evidence is only relevant when the information is available electronically, and at least one evidence reference is then expected.

evidenceReference.description: A reference to a piece of evidence available electronically. Aligns with UBL cac:Evidence. `id` is the evidence entity's OWN identity (owned by the producer), used as cac:Evidence/cbc:ID and as the cac:EvidenceSupplied/cbc:ID link target; `identifier` is the identity of the underlying document/record, a separate cac:DocumentReference/cbc:ID.

id.description: The evidence entity's own identity, supplied by the producer. Used to cross-link the answer to this evidence in the UBL XML (cac:EvidenceSupplied/cbc:ID -> cac:Evidence/cbc:ID). Must be unique within the document.

url.description: URL where the evidence can be accessed.

identifier.description: Optional identifier of the underlying document/record (e.g. a certificate number). Distinct from `id`.

description.description: Optional human description of the evidence.
